parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the end of the current query. Pass this token in the next call to retrieve the next page of results. The value is an empty string for the first call or when the last page is returned.
